frStory: Sur ces sommets, le vent ne cesse jamais de chanter. Une petite cloche recueille sa mélodie, pour la confier aux voyageurs quand tout devient silencieux.
enStory: On these peaks, the wind never stops singing. A little bell gathers its melody and shares it with travellers when everything falls silent.
scene: three rounded snowy mountain peaks above lavender clouds, peach sunrise, little brass wind bell hanging from a stone arch in the foreground
object: a small antique brass wind bell on a blue braided cord, tiny snowflake engraving

frStory: La mer a gardé les portes ouvertes de cette ancienne cité. Entre les colonnes, une clé de nacre attend qu’un ancien habitant revienne ouvrir sa porte.
enStory: The sea has kept the doors of this ancient city open. Between its columns, a mother-of-pearl key waits for a former resident to return and open their door.
scene: submerged ancient rounded stone arches and stairs beneath clear turquoise water, sunbeams, coral, a large mother-of-pearl key resting on a foreground pedestal
object: a single ornate mother-of-pearl antique key, turquoise ribbon and tiny pink coral accent

frStory: Les îles dérivent sans jamais se perdre de vue. Leurs habitants attachent un galet léger à leurs lettres : il retrouve toujours le courant qui mène à un ami.
enStory: The islands drift without ever losing sight of one another. Their inhabitants tie a weightless pebble to each letter: it always finds the breeze that leads to a friend.
scene: three rounded floating stone islands with grassy tops above peach clouds, rope bridge, foreground smooth pebble hovering above a ribbon
object: a smooth round lavender stone hovering inside a loose loop of golden ribbon, a few soft gold sparks

frStory: À la nuit tombée, mille lumières dessinent un chemin sur l’eau. On emporte d’ici un petit fanal vide : les lucioles préfèrent rester libres.
enStory: At nightfall, a thousand lights trace a path across the water. Travellers take home a little empty lantern: the fireflies prefer to stay free.
scene: quiet teal marsh at twilight, rounded mushrooms on mossy banks, curved wooden boardwalk, golden fireflies, empty little hanging lantern in foreground
object: a small empty open brass lantern with teal glass panes and curved handle, two golden fireflies flying outside

frStory: Sous le soleil, les dunes tintent comme du verre. Un sablier y mesure autre chose que les heures : le temps qu’il faut pour retrouver son émerveillement.
enStory: In the sunlight, the dunes chime like glass. Here, an hourglass measures something other than hours: the time it takes to find wonder again.
scene: sweeping peach sand dunes with large lavender and mint crystal clusters, warm sunset, one small brass hourglass on a foreground rock
object: a small brass hourglass filled with sparkling lilac crystal sand, rounded glass bulbs

frStory: Chaque hiver, le palais se construit une nouvelle salle. Une rose de givre attend sur le seuil ; dans la main d’un invité, elle ne fond jamais.
enStory: Each winter, the palace builds itself another room. A frost rose waits on the doorstep; in a guest’s hand, it never melts.
scene: rounded ice palace with translucent blue towers and lavender crystal windows, snowy garden, large icy rose near entrance, soft pink dawn
object: one translucent pale blue frost rose with silver stem and two crystalline leaves

frStory: Les racines ont remplacé les marches, mais le temple accueille ceux qui ont le pied léger. Une amulette de bois porte le souvenir de tous ceux qui s’y sont reposés.
enStory: Roots have replaced the steps, but the temple welcomes those who tread lightly. A wooden amulet holds the memory of everyone who has rested here.
scene: ancient rounded sandstone temple embraced by enormous tree roots, mossy stairs, green canopy, sunbeam on a carved wooden amulet on the threshold
object: a round carved wooden amulet with a simple spiral tree-root motif, moss-green cord

frStory: La cendre tombe ici aussi doucement que la neige. Au pied des palmiers noirs, une graine rouge attend la première pluie pour recommencer le monde.
enStory: Ash falls here as softly as snow. Beneath the dark palms, a red seed waits for the first rain to begin the world anew.
scene: small tropical island with charcoal sand, curved dark palm trees with copper fronds, calm plum sea, bright red sprouting seed in foreground, drifting soft ash, hopeful dawn
object: one large glowing red seed cradled in a dark split husk, tiny fresh green sprout

frStory: Sous la montagne, les spores dessinent un ciel à l’envers. Les voyageurs y ramassent une géode dont la lumière suffit à rassurer les nuits les plus longues.
enStory: Beneath the mountain, spores draw an upside-down sky. Travellers gather a geode whose light can soften even the longest night.
scene: rounded violet cavern with giant luminous blue mushrooms, golden spores on ceiling like constellations, open glowing geode in foreground, intimate cozy underground scene
object: an open rounded purple stone geode with softly glowing mint and lilac interior crystals

frStory: Les branches retiennent les nuages pour leur laisser le temps de rêver. Dans une tasse de feuille, une goutte de brume garde la fraîcheur matinale suspendue.
enStory: The branches hold the clouds long enough for them to dream. In a leaf cup, a drop of mist holds the morning freshness in suspension.
scene: high rounded treetops emerging from lavender mist, rope walkway between branches, golden morning rays, leaf-shaped cup collecting mist on foreground branch
object: a little folded green leaf teacup with twig handle, soft lavender mist curling above its rim

frStory: Les coraux de verre changent de couleur avec la marée. Une perle en garde tous les reflets, même très loin de l’océan.
enStory: The glass corals change colour with the tide. One pearl keeps all their reflections, even far from the ocean.
scene: clear shallow turquoise sea with rounded translucent pink and mint glass coral, sunlit ripples, large iridescent pearl in an open shell in foreground
object: a single large iridescent pearl nestled in a small translucent mint glass coral cradle

frStory: À midi, les jardins flottent dans une lumière dorée. Leurs jardiniers prêtent des arrosoirs aux nuages, qui n’oublient jamais de les rapporter pleins.
enStory: At noon, the gardens float in golden light. Their gardeners lend watering cans to the clouds, who always remember to bring them back full.
scene: sunny hanging terraced garden above fluffy clouds, elegant curved palms and round flowerbeds, small gold watering can on foreground terrace, blue and peach sky
object: a tiny golden watering can with a soft white cloud peeking out, rounded spout and mint handle

frStory: La neige a arrêté les horloges, sans éteindre les fenêtres. Une montre sans aiguilles rappelle qu’ici, personne n’est jamais en retard.
enStory: Snow has stopped the clocks without dimming the windows. A watch without hands is a reminder that here, nobody is ever late.
scene: quiet ancient rounded city square buried in soft snow, clock tower without clock hands, warm golden windows, an antique pocket watch on a foreground ledge
object: an antique brass pocket watch with a blank pearl clock face without hands or numbers, short chain, snow on top

frStory: Dans cette forêt, chaque feuille choisit sa propre couleur. Un prisme accroché à une branche offre un petit arc-en-ciel à qui prend le temps de regarder.
enStory: In this forest, every leaf chooses its own colour. A prism hanging from a branch offers a little rainbow to anyone who takes time to look.
scene: enchanted woodland with rounded trees and translucent gemlike leaves, pastel rainbow light across mossy path, large hanging triangular prism in foreground
object: a chunky translucent triangular crystal prism on a green cord, soft rainbow reflection, one small golden leaf charm

frStory: Les flammes veillent sur les noms que le temps a effacés. Une ancienne lampe entretient cette chaleur tranquille, comme une pensée pour les absents.
enStory: Flames watch over names that time has worn away. An ancient lamp keeps their quiet warmth alive, like a thought for those who are missed.
scene: peaceful ancient rounded stone memorials and arches at violet dusk, small warm flames in terracotta oil lamps, no readable inscriptions, gentle comforting mood, prominent oil lamp in foreground
object: a small rounded terracotta oil lamp with a steady golden flame and simple carved petal pattern

frStory: La neige enveloppe les arbres et les bruits du monde. Une plume blanche repose sur une souche, si légère qu’elle semble flotter dans le silence.
enStory: Snow wraps the trees and muffles the sounds of the world. A white feather rests on a stump, so light it seems to float in the silence.
scene: quiet snowy forest with rounded evergreen trees, lavender shadows, winding untouched snow path and single large white feather on foreground stump, soft dawn
object: a single curved white feather with pale blue shading and a small silver ribbon tied to its quill

frStory: Dans les alcôves, des sphères recueillent les spores dorées des champignons. Un médaillon en garde quelques-unes, dont la douce lumière accompagne le voyageur.
enStory: In the alcoves, spheres gather the mushrooms’ golden spores. A medallion holds a few of them, their gentle light accompanying the traveller.
scene: moss-covered ancient circular sanctuary with mushroom clusters, stone alcoves holding glowing spore orbs, purple and gold light, round medallion on central low altar
object: a round antique brass medallion with a clear amber center containing luminous golden spores, violet cord

frStory: Des champignons légers voyagent de nuage en nuage. Leurs petites ombrelles ne protègent pas de la pluie : elles apprennent aux rêves à voler.
enStory: Weightless mushrooms travel from cloud to cloud. Their little parasols do not keep out the rain: they teach dreams to fly.
scene: fantastical kingdom of giant pastel mushroom platforms floating among cream clouds, tiny mushroom-cap parasol drifting in foreground, lavender and peach sky
object: one small lavender mushroom-cap parasol with cream spots and curved golden handle, soft cloud puff beneath

frStory: Les nuages rouges se racontent leurs colères à coups d’éclairs. Quand ils se taisent, il reste parfois une étincelle, tiède et douce au creux d’un flacon.
enStory: The red clouds tell each other their troubles in flashes of lightning. When they fall quiet, a spark sometimes remains, warm and gentle inside a tiny bottle.
scene: rounded scarlet and coral storm clouds above a calm plum landscape, one gentle golden lightning arc, small corked bottle containing a lightning spark on foreground ridge, magical not threatening
object: a round clear glass bottle with copper stopper containing one tiny golden lightning bolt, coral reflections

frStory: Les palmiers portent des franges de neige sous les aurores. Un bracelet tressé de lumière garde au poignet les couleurs de cette nuit impossible.
enStory: The palms wear fringes of snow beneath the aurora. A bracelet woven from light keeps the colours of this impossible night around your wrist.
scene: snowy tropical ring island with frosted curved palm trees, turquoise lagoon edged with ice, green and violet aurora in night sky, luminous woven bracelet on foreground snow
object: a circular braided bracelet of mint green violet and turquoise glowing strands, small silver snowflake charm

frStory: Les escaliers montent encore, même là où les palais ont disparu. Un fragment de mosaïque montre une étoile : peut-être l’adresse de leurs anciens habitants.
enStory: The stairways still climb, even where the palaces have vanished. A mosaic fragment shows a star: perhaps the address of those who once lived here.
scene: ancient cream stone arches and broken stairs suspended above golden clouds, lavender sky, large blue and gold star mosaic fragment on foreground ledge
object: a rounded broken blue ceramic mosaic fragment with one golden star inlaid at center, warm terracotta edges

frStory: Une vague s’est arrêtée juste avant de rejoindre le rivage. Dans une petite boule de verre, son écume continue pourtant de danser.
enStory: A wave stopped just before reaching the shore. Inside a little glass globe, its sea foam still dances.
scene: a giant curling ocean wave frozen into translucent turquoise ice near snowy shore, peach horizon, small glass snowglobe containing a wave in foreground
object: a small clear glass globe on a round carved blue wooden base containing one tiny turquoise curling wave and white foam

frStory: Les lianes brillent sans brûler et les fleurs s’ouvrent à la chaleur. Un fruit-lanterne accompagne les voyageurs jusqu’à la lisière, puis garde leur chemin en mémoire.
enStory: The vines glow without burning and flowers open in the warmth. A lantern fruit guides travellers to the forest’s edge, then remembers their path.
scene: lush rounded tropical forest with glowing coral vines and warm luminous orange fruits, emerald leaves, winding path, large lantern fruit in foreground, no destructive fire
object: a glowing orange lantern-shaped fruit in a delicate green leaf husk, curved stem and two rounded leaves

frStory: Les jardiniers arrosent les champignons avec des reflets de lune. Au matin, une fleur de gemme a poussé : elle ne demande ni eau ni vase, seulement un peu de lumière.
enStory: The gardeners water their mushrooms with moonlight. By morning, a gem flower has grown: it needs neither water nor a vase, only a little light.
scene: whimsical garden with rounded crystal mushrooms in pink and lavender, emerald moss beds, moonlit sky, one prominent gemstone flower in foreground
object: one small gemstone flower with rounded translucent rose quartz petals, golden center and jade green crystal stem

frStory: Les dunes déplacent les rues pendant que la cité dort. Une petite lampe indique toujours la direction de l’oasis, même quand toutes les routes ont changé.
enStory: The dunes move the streets while the city sleeps. A little lamp always points towards the oasis, even when every road has changed.
scene: ancient rounded sandstone city half-buried in peach dunes, domes and arches, small palm oasis, golden sunrise, turquoise brass lamp on foreground step
object: a little ornate brass travelling lamp with turquoise enamel, rounded belly and curved long spout, a soft mint wisp

frStory: D’un côté, la braise ; de l’autre, le givre. Au-dessus de la faille, deux rubans noués restent tièdes : les contraires savent parfois se tenir chaud.
enStory: Embers on one side, frost on the other. Above the rift, two knotted ribbons stay warm: sometimes opposites know how to keep each other cosy.
scene: rounded canyon split between glowing coral volcanic rock and pale blue icy rock, narrow natural stone bridge, two knotted ribbons tied on bridge post, soft violet sky
object: two broad ribbons tied together into one graceful knot, one ember orange with gold flecks, one icy blue with white snowflake motifs

frStory: Ici, les étoiles descendent assez bas pour regarder dans les télescopes. Une lentille de poche garde un coin de ciel, pour les soirs où les nuages cachent tout.
enStory: Here, the stars come down low enough to look through the telescopes. A pocket lens keeps a patch of sky for evenings when clouds hide everything.
scene: rounded brass and crystal observatory dome on a cloud terrace, large telescope pointed toward low golden stars, deep lavender night, small starry pocket lens on foreground parapet
object: a round brass pocket magnifying lens with a short carved handle, midnight blue glass containing a few tiny golden stars
